user.title: Connect to a HiveMind hub
user.description: Enter the credentials issued by `hivemind-core add-client` on your hub.

data.name: Name
data.legacy_audio: Use the legacy audio service instead of OCP

data_description.host: Hub address — hostname or IP, e.g. 192.168.1.10; ws:// or wss:// optional
data_description.port: Must match your hub's listener; default 5678
data_description.site_id: Optional grouping label; leave as-is if you have one hub
data_description.name: Friendly name shown in Home Assistant, e.g. 'Living Room HiveMind'
data_description.legacy_audio: OCP is the OVOS media-playback system; enable this to use the older audio service instead

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the hub. Check the host, port, and that hivemind-core is running.
error.invalid_auth: The hub answered but rejected the connection. Check the access key and password (from hivemind-core list-clients) — and confirm the port matches your hub's listener.
